paragraphs: R. Chanan: “Rabbi said”—Sukkah 15b, 16a. “R. Yaakov bar Idi said”—Chullin 5b. In R. Meir's name: Megillah 12a; so too Yalkut, in the name of Midrash Abba Guryon. Ein Yaakov has R. Anan in R. Meir's name.
